scope: read-only neutral SEO CLI evidence collection

tools.install_policy: No additional dependency; use the repository Python runtime.
use_when: A client-facing audit needs bounded agent discoverability, machine-readable content, bot policy, or emerging agent protocol evidence.
avoid_when: The request requires proof of AI visibility, citations, traffic, or successful agent transactions.
do_not_claim: Agent-readiness checks do not prove AI visibility, citations, traffic, or agent success.
Missing API, MCP, or commerce surfaces are not defects for sites that do not offer those capabilities.

tools.install_policy: Do not install automatically. Ask before installing or updating.
tools.approval_class: external_read for live URLs; read_only for local artifacts
use_when: A broad crawl should collect technical SEO, metadata, OpenGraph, links, security, accessibility-adjacent, performance-adjacent, sitemap, and report evidence.
A site audit needs one primary crawler before specialist tools run.
avoid_when: The user only needs a local Markdown link check.
The target is production-sensitive and crawl bounds are unclear.
do_not_claim: A clean crawl is not a ranking, indexing, traffic, or conversion guarantee.
Security and accessibility checks are hygiene evidence, not proof of legal or ranking compliance.

tools.install_policy: Do not install automatically. Ask before installing or updating.
use_when: A site-wide Lighthouse-style scan is needed.
Performance, accessibility, best-practice, and SEO lab checks need repeated sampling across multiple URLs.
avoid_when: Only one URL needs Lighthouse evidence; use lighthouse directly.
Field Core Web Vitals are required; use CrUX or PageSpeed field data where available.
do_not_claim: Lighthouse lab data is not field Core Web Vitals.
A Lighthouse SEO score is not a ranking guarantee.

tools.install_policy: Do not install automatically. Ask before installing or updating.
use_when: One URL needs detailed lab performance and Lighthouse category evidence.
A before/after check needs the same command and target repeated.
avoid_when: A whole site needs route discovery; use unlighthouse or siteone-crawler first.
do_not_claim: Lab performance is not field performance.
Category scores are heuristics, not direct business impact.

tools.install_policy: Do not install automatically. Ask before installing or updating.
tools.approval_class: external_read for live URLs; read_only for local files
use_when: Focused broken-link validation is needed for a page, URL list, generated site, or docs tree.
A link check should be cheaper than a full SEO crawl.
avoid_when: The question requires full crawl metadata, canonicals, headings, schema, or rendering evidence.
do_not_claim: A link check only covers the checked URLs and current response state.

tools.install_policy: Do not install automatically. Ask before installing or updating.
tools.approval_class: external_read for live URLs; read_only for local files
use_when: Repository Markdown, HTML, or source files need link validation.
CI-style link checking is more useful than a browser crawl.
avoid_when: The page's rendered DOM changes link targets materially.
do_not_claim: Local source-link checks do not prove rendered navigation is correct.

tools.install_policy: Do not install automatically. Ask before installing or updating.
use_when: Local HTML, generated pages, or template output need fast validation before deployment.
A framework project can validate build output without crawling production.
avoid_when: Only live rendered browser behavior can reveal the issue.
do_not_claim: HTML validation is not SEO ranking evidence by itself.

tools.install_policy: Do not install automatically. Ask before installing or updating.
tools.approval_class: external_read for live URLs; read_only for local files
use_when: Full-document HTML conformance needs an independent validator.
Generated HTML should be checked before publishing or deployment.
avoid_when: The runtime environment cannot run the validator safely or consistently.
do_not_claim: HTML conformance is not a ranking guarantee.

tools.install_policy: Do not install automatically. Ask before installing or updating.
tools.approval_class: external_read for live URLs; read_only for local files served locally
use_when: Accessibility-adjacent issues may affect page quality, usability, or crawlable content presentation.
A small set of important pages needs targeted accessibility evidence.
avoid_when: The request needs a full accessibility compliance audit.
A legal compliance conclusion is expected.
do_not_claim: Pa11y output is not a legal accessibility compliance verdict.
Accessibility findings should not be collapsed into an SEO score without labels.
